rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes uniform melt pool dynamics and reduced thermal gradients to minimize defects, whereas the target mechanism involves carbon retention, reduced gas evolution, and oxide effects during debinding and solid-state sintering. These are different classes of mechanism.
